role: Complete S3 for the frozen ten-interaction family using its exact immutable 999x10 joint null distribution rather than an approximation. This is design/power interpretation only and cannot change the observed 0/10 Holm decision.

simulation.joint_noise: sample rows with replacement from the exact frozen 999x10 null-statistic matrix, thereby preserving the empirical cross-interaction dependence structure
simulation.alternative: add the fixed effect only to the target interaction statistic; all other interaction statistics retain the sampled joint-null values
simulation.per_interaction_p: same frozen two-sided absolute-tail empirical p against that interaction's 999 null values: (1 + count(|null| >= |stat|))/1000
simulation.multiplicity: Holm across exactly all ten interaction p-values
simulation.targets: all ten interactions, no selection based on observed raw or Holm p-values

outputs: target one-test power by effect size
target Holm power by effect size
family any-discovery probability by effect size
smallest grid effect with target Holm power >=0.8 for every interaction

observed_reference_only_after_simulation.rule: Observed values may be located relative to the already-frozen power curve, but are not used to tune the effect grid or family.
